scope: Selected original passages/abstracts; no complete independent risk-of-bias or qualified clinical review

checks.locator: Updated Cochrane review abstract, search to 7 Jan 2025
checks.finding: Preeclampsia RR 0.83 (95% CI 0.67–1.04), 6 trials, 15,364 women, low certainty. Clear preventive benefit not established in this analysis.
checks.limitations: Trustworthiness exclusions materially affect pooled estimates. Calcium adequacy and targeted hypertension prevention differ; do not independently change clinical guidance.
checks.funding: Review-level and contributing-trial disclosure not fully re-extracted.

checks.finding: Commentary challenges exclusions in the updated review; not a new efficacy trial.
checks.limitations: Different inclusion decisions need sensitivity analysis. Prior authorship is an intellectual interest, not evidence of distortion.
checks.coi: Two authors contributed to earlier Cochrane calcium reviews; third declared no competing interests.

checks.finding: Preeclampsia RR 1.85 (95% CI 1.04–3.29), four trials/955 women; review rated evidence high certainty.
checks.limitations: Specific pregnancy prevention trials; not evidence about every fermented food, strain or infant population. Preserve review overlap and safety signal.
checks.funding: Full review and trial funding not newly completed.

checks.locator: 2025 AHRQ report overview and Pediatrics companion review funding
checks.finding: Several favorable child health associations; no clear optimal breastfeeding-duration threshold identified. Certainty differs by endpoint.
checks.limitations: Most comparisons observational, with residual confounding and heterogeneous feeding definitions.
checks.funding: AHRQ contract; companion review reports CDC/AHRQ funding.
checks.scope: original report summary and companion publication excerpt checked

checks.locator: PLOS funding, competing interests and design; 16-year follow-up
checks.finding: Randomized breastfeeding promotion, not assigned milk type; existing outcome extraction reports limited verbal-function difference, not broad cognitive advantage.
checks.limitations: One PROBIT cohort, attrition and cognitive measurement; instrument-company interests relevant.
checks.funding: CIHR MOP-53155, NIH R01HD050758, public institutional support.
checks.coi: Two authors employed by NeuroTrax, whose cognitive battery was used.
checks.scope: selected full-text disclosure and design passages checked

checks.finding: 31 Belarus sites assigned to breastfeeding-promotion support or usual care, not breastfeeding versus formula assignment.
checks.limitations: Cluster randomization and downstream exposure differences; follow-ups are same cohort.

checks.finding: High-risk term infants: eczema by age two 139/598 versus 150/612; adjusted RR 0.95 (95% CI 0.78–1.16). No clear preventive benefit; skin infection signal reported.
checks.limitations: High-risk population, specified products and outcome definitions; separate prevention from eczema treatment.
checks.funding: UK NIHR Health Technology Assessment programme.
checks.coi: Several outside-work industry relationships, institutional Nestlé partnership, and funding-programme affiliations disclosed; investigators affiliated with programme were not involved in its award decision.
checks.scope: selected full-text results and disclosure passages checked

checks.locator: Abstract, results, funding/support and role of sponsor
checks.finding: US pragmatic RCT, 1,247 dyads not selected for high risk: eczema incidence 36.1% vs 43.0% at 24 months, RR 0.84 (95% CI 0.73–0.97).
checks.limitations: Different risk selection from BEEP, missing-outcome imputation and formulation switching; no basis for brand ranking or universal prevention regimen.
checks.funding: NIH NIAMS AR071057 and NIH data-platform support.
checks.coi: L'Oreal, Galderma and Pharmaceutical Specialties supplied products; authors report companies not involved in trial design, implementation, analysis or reporting; outside-work industry ties disclosed.
checks.scope: selected full-text results and disclosures checked

checks.finding: FDA warned of potentially fatal invasive infection in preterm infants given live-microbe probiotics and reported an associated death.
checks.limitations: Regulatory safety warning, not efficacy trial or risk denominator; NICU populations differ from healthy term infants.
checks.funding: FDA safety communication, not a trial.
